title: Popup from OptionButton and MenuButton does not consider scroll container's content_margin of stylebox for minimum size
body:
### Tested versions

First reproduced in 4.4.2
Still can reproduce in 4.6


### System information

Windows 11 - OpenGL API 3.3.0 NVIDIA 581.80 - Compatibility - Using Device: NVIDIA - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Laptop GPU

### Issue description

When editing a theme you theme you can set a style to the Scroll Container, adding some content_margings will prevent the clipping of the scroll container to cut the focus box of buttons, but this is not considered for the calculation of minimum size of popups

### Steps to reproduce

- Create a theme resource
- Create an style for ScrollContainer
- Assign a new StyleBoxEmpy/Flat/Texture
- Assign some value to content_margin_top/bottom/left/right of the stylebox
- Assign the theme to the project or to an OptionButton/MenuButton. **Possibly could affect other nodes too**
- Run the project and open the menues
